    StartersTangier lamb kofta skewersSpiced lamb kofta grilled on skewers, harissa yoghurt to dipHow to make it500g lamb mince1 brown onion, grated1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp chopped parsley1 tsp salt1 tbsp harissa300g Greek yoghurtMix the lamb with the onion, cumin, parsley and salt.Shape around skewers.Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through.Stir the harissa through the yoghurt and serve as a dip.Aegean dive grilled octopusBaby octopus marinated in lemon and oregano, grilled hot, with capersHow to make it600g baby octopus, cleaned3 tbsp olive oil2 lemons, one juiced and one in wedges1 tbsp dried oregano2 tbsp capersMarinate the octopus in the oil, lemon juice and oregano for an hour.Grill on a very hot plate for 2 to 3 minutes until charred and just tender.Pile onto a plate, scatter with capers and serve with lemon wedges.Apollo 11 parade soft pretzelsThe 1969 ticker tape parade in New YorkHow to make itAs written, serves 4New York street-cart soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with spicy brown mustard.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour.Shape 8 big pretzels and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds.Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 1 tsp hot English mustard and 1 tsp honey to serve.Sicilian arancini with saffron and peasArchimedes' tomb can wait until after lunch.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMoroccan chicken tagineChicken thighs simmered with saffron, preserved lemon and green olives, over couscousHow to make it1kg chicken thighs2 tbsp oil1 brown onion, sliced1 tbsp grated gingersaffron threads, a pinch500ml water1 preserved lemon, chopped100g green olives250g couscousBrown the chicken in the oil.Soften the onion with the ginger and saffron. Add the water, preserved lemon and olives.Cover and simmer until tender.Steep the couscous in hot water, fluff with a fork and serve under the tagine.Syracuse swordfish with caponataThe journey to Syracuse in SicilyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Swordfish steaks seared golden, finished with a sweet and sour caponata of eggplant, tomato, olives, capers and pine nuts, with crusty bread.Cube an eggplant and fry in olive oil until golden.Add a sliced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften.Stir in 400g crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 50g green olives and 1 tbsp capers and simmer 15 minutes.Toast 30g pine nuts and stir through with basil.Season 4 swordfish steaks and sear 2 minutes a side.Serve on the caponata with crusty bread.SweetsSyracuse almond granita with briocheIcy almond granita served with soft briocheHow to make it200g ground almonds800ml water150g caster sugar1 tsp almond extract4 brioche bunsBlend the almonds, water and sugar, stand for 30 minutes and strain well through a cloth, squeezing hard.Stir in the almond extract, pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 40 minutes until fluffy ice crystals form.Warm the brioche at 160°C for 5 minutes. Spoon the granita into glasses and serve with the brioche.DrinksMint tea in TangierGreen tea and fresh mint with sugar, poured from a height to frothHow to make it2 tbsp green tea leaves1 big bunch mint4 tbsp caster sugar, to taste1 L just-boiled waterPut the green tea, mint and sugar in a teapot and pour over the hot water.Steep for 4 minutes.Pour from a height into small glasses so it froths, then pour back and pour again.Limoncello spritzTeddy's pour, nicked from somebody else's table.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
